# Katherine Kleyman, Esq.

> Plaintiff-side employment attorney representing employees in New York and California across a full range of employment law matters.

Katherine Kleyman is a former corporate counsel and Fordham University School of Law graduate. She represents workers, not employers. The firm handles wrongful termination, discrimination (race, gender, age, disability, and more), harassment (sexual, verbal, or physical), wage and hour violations, whistleblower retaliation, employee misclassification, missed meals and rest breaks, unpaid overtime, hostile work environment, FMLA violations, FEHA violations, NYSHRL violations, breach of employment contract, and retaliation for reporting unsafe or unlawful conditions. Free case reviews are available for potential employment claims, and paid strategy sessions are available for employees seeking focused guidance while still employed. Contingency-based representation is available in qualified cases.

Contact: 1-646-583-5001 · 221 Kings Hwy, Brooklyn, NY 11223
Canonical website: https://www.kleymanesq.com
